title: Special Topics in Bioengineering with Laboratory
description: Course given at the discretion of the faculty on current topics of interest in bioengineering. This course is intended to be a lecture and lab component topics course. This course will cover topics from biomechanics, biosystems, bioinformatics and biotechnology among others. Prerequisites: bioengineering majors only (BE25, BE27, BE28, BE29) or consent of department. (F,W,S)
